step_stone_1.notes: Light stone footstep (heel tap + toe tap + grit); rotate the 4 variants, add +/-1.5 dB random volume and +/-4% pitch.

step_stone_2.notes: Light stone footstep (heel tap + toe tap + grit); rotate the 4 variants, add +/-1.5 dB random volume and +/-4% pitch.

step_stone_3.notes: Light stone footstep (heel tap + toe tap + grit); rotate the 4 variants, add +/-1.5 dB random volume and +/-4% pitch.

step_stone_4.notes: Light stone footstep (heel tap + toe tap + grit); rotate the 4 variants, add +/-1.5 dB random volume and +/-4% pitch.

land.notes: Landing from a jump/knockback: low thump, dust and a small scuff.

evade_whoosh.notes: Quick body-evade swish: narrow cloth-like band sweep, low in level.

dash_air.notes: Air-propelled dash: pressure pop, bright rising sweep and a hissing tail.

whoosh_light.notes: Fast light strike swish; mid-high band sweep.

whoosh_heavy.notes: Heavy strike swing: lower, wider, with body and saturation.

hit_light.notes: Light impact: crisp click, slap and short body knock.

hit_heavy.notes: Heavy impact: crack, saturated body thud, crunch and room tail.

block.notes: Dull solid thud for a blocked hit. Dark, no ring, no top end; contrasts with deflect.

deflect.notes: Bright clean ring/ping for a successful deflect. Rewarding, distinct from block.

perfect_deflect.notes: Deflect ping plus a short rising crystalline shimmer; the premium variant.

control_lost.notes: Strained descending grind: jittery detuned buzz with a downward formant, for loss of elemental control.

guard_break.notes: Guard shattered: sharp crack, stone/glass fragments, descending break tone and low boom.

knockdown.notes: Body slam to the ground: big thud, smaller bounce, gravel slide and dust.

stone_rip.notes: Stone pulled out of the ground: initial crack then stick-slip grind and a release pop.

stone_launch.notes: Stone thrown: low release thump with grit, then a receding whoosh.

stone_impact_1.notes: Boulder/stone hit: solid body thud, dead stone ring, a spray of debris.

stone_impact_2.notes: Stone hit, cracking/crumbling variant: split-crack, lower thump, more debris.

stone_roll_loop.notes: Boulder rolling: lumpy low rumble, gritty mids, pebble ticks (loop 2.0 s).

wall_raise.notes: Stone wall rising: building rumble and grind, then a heavy slam with debris.

wall_crumble.notes: Wall collapsing: cracks, falling blocks, dense then thinning rubble and dust.

heat_crackle_loop.notes: Stone heating: ticks, resonant cracks, faint sizzle (loop 2.0 s).

melt_rise.notes: Stone becoming molten: heat swell opening up, glowing tone, bubbles emerging (~1.1 s).

lava_bubble_loop.notes: Thick, low viscous bubbling with soft pops and faint crackle (loop 2.0 s).

lava_wave_loop.notes: Rushing viscous lava flow: dark thick surge with slow swells and slow gurgle (loop 2.0 s).

lava_splat.notes: Lava poured onto the ground: wet slap, low thud, viscous blobs and sizzle.

crust_hiss.notes: Cooling crust forming: hiss with sparse ticks over a dull warm body (~1 s). Darker and more crackly than steam_hiss.

cool_crack.notes: Rock cracking as it sets: quick series of dwindling resonant cracks and a tiny settle.

heat_draw_loop.notes: Tonal inward-pulling whoosh: endlessly rising Shepard glide under a breathy inhale (loop 2.0 s).

vent_heat.notes: Exhaling flame burst: soft-attack breathy roar with pressure thump and dwindling crackle.

water_draw_loop.notes: Water being drawn in: flowing band, rolling swirl resonance, bubbly plinks (loop 2.0 s).

water_whip.notes: Water lash: fast rising whoosh into a sharp wet crack, then droplet spray.

water_splash.notes: Splash: bright noise burst that darkens, droplet/bubble scatter, watery body.

water_shield_loop.notes: Water barrier: smooth shimmering flow, glassy partials and liquid wobble (loop 2.0 s).

freeze.notes: Water crystallizing: dense glassy crunch grains, icy twinkles, cold hiss (~0.9 s).

ice_shatter.notes: Ice breaking: bright crack, small body knock, shower of glassy shards.

ice_melt_drip.notes: Three melting drips with a faint trickle and small-room echo.

steam_hiss.notes: Pure breathy steam release: bright hiss with air band and gentle flutter (~1 s).

fire_jab.notes: Quick flame punch: sharp flare burst, snappy thump, pops and a short ember tail.

fire_charge_loop.notes: Fire energy building: low roar with flutter, flame hiss and crackle, subtle rising tone (loop 2.0 s).

fire_release.notes: Fire blast release: pressure thump, wide roar that falls in pitch, whoosh, crackle tail.

fire_ignite.notes: Ignition: spark flick, a soft gas 'whump' flare, settling crackle.

lightning_charge_loop.notes: Building electrical buzz: beating mains-style hum, bright spark ticks and a rising whine (loop 2.0 s).

lightning_strike.notes: Sharp crack with zap, low boom and a buzzy sizzling tail.

lightning_redirect.notes: Strike that twists mid-air: first crack, warbling pitch-bent buzz, a second rising zap.

conduct_buzz.notes: Short electrical buzz crossing water/metal: gated harmonic buzz, metallic ring, sparks.

air_push.notes: Palm air push: low pressure pulse, quick band-passed gust, airy tail.

air_gust.notes: Wide wind gust: swelling resonant band with turbulence, breathy body and airy top.

glide_loop.notes: Gentle gliding wind: smooth wandering resonances, no events (loop 2.0 s).

ui_tap.notes: Soft tick for taps and hovers.

ui_select.notes: Confirm: soft rising pair (D5 to A5).

ui_back.notes: Back/cancel: softer falling pair (A5 to D5), a little darker.

element_earth.notes: Earth motif: low warm A3-D4 pluck pair with a stone knock.

element_water.notes: Water motif: falling droplet-like D5-A4 ripple, soft vibrato glass.

element_fire.notes: Fire motif: quick rising D4-F#4-A4-D5 arpeggio, bright with a crackle accent.

element_air.notes: Air motif: high breathy A5-E6 sigh with a soft upward glide.

unlock.notes: Warm reward motif: rising D-major pentatonic bell arpeggio resolving to a soft chord.

challenge_fail.notes: Restrained fail cue: muted falling F4-D4 pluck pair over a soft low knock; no buzzer.

amb_courtyard_loop.notes: Quiet courtyard bed: distant airy wind and soft leaf-rustle air, very low level (-18 dBFS peak) (loop 3.0 s).

metal_clang.notes: Struck metal: sharp tink, inharmonic bar ring (ratios 1/2.76/5.4/8.9) with a detuned shimmer. Bright and metallic, unlike the harmonic glassy deflect ping.

metal_scrape.notes: Blade on plate: stick-slip grind in the 1.2-5 kHz band over a ringing, wandering squeal.

disc_whirr_loop.notes: Spinning disc: blade-pass buzz (11 Hz) on a 540 Hz harmonic stack with air and a high ring (loop 2.0 s).

magnet_hum_loop.notes: Magnetic field: 147 Hz mains-style hum with a slow 1.5 Hz beat, strong 2nd-6th harmonics (phone-safe) and a faint mid band (loop 2.0 s).

metal_recall.notes: Metal called back to the hand: rising metallic zip with a shimmering tone and a small clink on arrival.

rod_hum_loop.notes: Resonant rod: pure 587.5 Hz tone with vibrato, a detuned beating twin and thin high shimmer (loop 2.0 s).

sand_hiss.notes: Sand pouring: dry bright hiss (3.5-5 kHz) with a grain tick scatter.

sand_burst.notes: Sand blast: wide dry noise puff that darkens quickly, a spray of grains and a soft pressure thump.

sand_surge_loop.notes: Sand stream rushing: dense grain wash with slow surges (loop 2.0 s).

sandstorm_loop.notes: Sandstorm: wide howling wind with wandering formants, driving grit and a low roar; slow gusts (loop 3.0 s).

quicksand_loop.notes: Quicksand: hollow suction gurgle, slow sucking sweeps, wet gulps and a little grit (loop 2.0 s).

glass_fuse.notes: Sand fusing to glass: accelerating grain ticks, a rising crystalline shimmer and a bright glassy ring as it sets.

glass_shatter.notes: Glass breaking: sharp bright crack and a shower of pitched shards (2.5-9.5 kHz) with sparse chimes. No body knock, which separates it from ice_shatter.

magma_glob.notes: Molten blob: wet slap, a viscous low-mid bloop that sags in pitch, and a quick sizzle.

magma_surge.notes: Magma surging: dark roar swelling upward with a heavy thump, thick bubbles and crackle.

obsidian_set.notes: Lava setting to black glass: dwindling resonant ticks and a dark glassy ring (single fall, fewer shards than glass_shatter).

lava_hiss_quench.notes: Lava hit by water: big hiss burst with a sputter of low pops, a dull thump and a crackle tail (steam_jet is cleaner, higher and has no pops).

wave_rush_loop.notes: Tidal wave rushing: broad churning water with slow surges, foam top and a weighty low band (loop 2.0 s).

water_jet_loop.notes: Pressurised water jet: tight steady 2.5-9 kHz hiss with a narrow resonant band and a light flutter (loop 2.0 s).

ice_wall_raise.notes: Ice wall growing: rising stream of crystal ticks, a creaking resonance, then a solid thunk and glassy ring.

ice_crack.notes: Ice cracking: sharp crack with a falling resonant chirp, then two smaller dwindling cracks.

ice_slide_loop.notes: Sliding on ice: smooth silky hiss, a squeaking resonance that drifts, and sparse scrape ticks (loop 2.0 s).

frost_hiss.notes: Frost forming: cold 5.5-12 kHz hiss with twinkling sparkles; colder and thinner than steam_hiss.

mist_loop.notes: Fog bank: soft diffuse hush, slowly drifting; very quiet shimmering top and rare tiny droplets (loop 3.0 s).

steam_jet.notes: Hard steam jet: sharp-onset 1.8-8 kHz hiss with fast flutter and a tiny pressure pop; cleaner and brighter than lava_hiss_quench.

geyser.notes: Geyser: rising rumble, a sudden roaring water column, a splash and falling droplets with steam.

vine_creak.notes: Vine straining: slow stick-slip woody creak (pulse train through a drifting ~600 Hz formant) with small fibre ticks.

vine_snap.notes: Vine snapping: sharp woody crack, a brief twang and a fibrous tear.

vine_burn.notes: Green vine burning: wet sizzle and steam hiss with popping sap and crackle.

fireball_whoosh.notes: Fireball passing: roaring whoosh that swells and falls with a low-mid body and crackle in its wake.

fire_field_loop.notes: Burning ground: dense crackle over a low breathing roar and faint hiss (loop 2.0 s).

blue_roar_loop.notes: Blue flame: smooth turbine-like jet hiss with a resonant 2.2 kHz ring, a faint 1.65 kHz whine and almost no crackle (loop 2.0 s).

blue_ignite.notes: Blue flame lighting: spark tick, a tight gas 'fwoomp' and a rising whine that settles into a jet hiss.

spark_snap.notes: Tiny electric snap: a sharp dry click with a fast falling zap and one or two after-ticks.

thunderclap.notes: Thunderclap: broadband rip then a heavy boom that rolls away in echoing rumbles. No zap or buzz tail, which separates it from lightning_strike.

static_crackle_loop.notes: Static charge field: sparse dry sparks and snaps with a faint high hiss and no tonal hum (loop 2.0 s).

explosion_small.notes: Small explosion: short sharp bang, tight thump and a handful of fragments.

explosion_large.notes: Large explosion: a deep long boom, a long rolling rumble and a dense debris shower; scale (length, weight, level) grows with tier.

fuse_tick.notes: Burning fuse: a woody tick over a short sizzle; repeat for a countdown.

crescent_whoosh.notes: Blade of air: a thin, fast, high band sweep (1.4-5 kHz) with a singing edge tone.

tornado_loop.notes: Tornado: two wandering howl formants rotating once per second over a low roar, debris ticks and a wide mid wash (loop 3.0 s).

vacuum_implode.notes: Air collapsing inward: a falling, ever louder suction sweep that ends in a sudden pop and a hollow breath.

vacuum_loop.notes: Vacuum pocket: a hollow, endlessly falling Shepard glide under a dull 200-1400 Hz breath; feels like absence (loop 2.0 s).

sonic_boom.notes: Sonic boom: two crisp shock cracks 35 ms apart, a hard pressure thump and a falling airy wash; dry and short (thunderclap rolls, this does not).

roar_wave.notes: Roar wave: a rough falling 190-85 Hz voice-like buzz opened by sweeping vowel formants, with breath noise and a heavy front.

echo_ping.notes: Sonar ping: a soft A5 sine ping repeated as three ever darker, quieter echoes (single plain ping, unlike the glassy deflect ring).

flight_loop.notes: Sustained flight: steady rushing wind with a wandering mid band, thin whistle and gentle flutter; fuller than glide_loop (loop 2.0 s).

charge_t1.notes: Charge tier 1: one small rising D5 pluck with a faint airy sweep.

charge_t2.notes: Charge tier 2: rising D5 to A5 pair over a held fifth, brighter and longer.

charge_t3.notes: Charge tier 3 (full): fast D5-A5-D6 arpeggio into a bell chord with sparkle and a low weight pulse.

counter_success.notes: Counter landed: a solid catch thump, then a warm rising D-major bell chord (D5-F#5-A5) over an upward sweep. A chord, so it can never be confused with the single deflect ping or the dull block thud.

counter_fail.notes: Counter failed: a heavy muffled thump, a falling saturated buzz and a sinking noise wash. No ring, no bell; darker and harsher than challenge_fail.

clash_solid.notes: Two solid bodies meeting: a hard crack, a heavy thock, a short dead stone ring and a bounce echo; harder and cracklier than block.

clash_energy.notes: Two energies colliding: a bright noise flash, a fast falling zap, crackle and a shimmering pressure thump; sizzly and unpitched compared with clash_solid.
